title: Pull the image generator and the vision judge models
goal: Pull the image generator and the vision judge models
acceptance: Owner runs the steps the agent wrote into the decision page's "Pull the models" section for runtime B (F-021-T06): checks the installed judge gemma4:12b against its manifest digest, installs ComfyUI v0.46.0 at its pinned commit, fetches the Qwen Image 2.1 Turbo files at a fixed Hugging Face commit and checks their SHA-256; the digest and hashes are recorded in the record (a download starts only on this explicit request)
privacy: Neutral invented cases and fixtures only; no consumer data, private reports or credentials in Git.
validation: Owner reports the pulled digests; recorded in the record
escalation: No knowledge of any consumer; a consumer-specific need goes to that consumer's backlog
Material scope or effort growth goes to the owner before adoption

effort.basis: Planned 2026-11-26; owner time only, download wait not counted. Raised from 0.25 h on 2026-11-26 because runtime B adds a ComfyUI install to the pulls, within the 1 to 2 h the owner accepted for B.
